status: Negative for residual training; fixed fusion in the new decoder is the only arm ahead of LM-only, and not significantly on held-out.
question: Does training the 25M so that conditional + 1.5*LM ranks the gold first beat LM-only or fixed fusion in the new text decoder?

protocol.heldout: 122 documents / 366 rows frozen before training (seed wime-residual-fusion-heldout120-20261028); 20 per non-technical category, 1 each kubernetes/python because the technical test pool is exhausted; disjoint from all 571 previously evaluated documents.
protocol.dev: accuracy-expansion 120 documents / 360 rows (previously inspected), used only for checkpoint selection.
protocol.mining: 6000 train rows from 2000 parents (whole/suffix/single, 25% blank whole), deployed text decoder with Qwen3.5-2B and 25M guide; top-16 candidates with LM and conditional components. Gold in pool 5886, LM top1 5431.
protocol.pairs: 21937 pairs: gold vs up to 4 wrong candidates preferred by LM or by fixed fusion; priors = per-character LM score, prior weight 1.5.
protocol.training: Continue 1c9b9e78, 4000 steps, lr 1e-5, CE recipe of ranking-refresh; arms ranking weight 0 (CE control), 0.5, 2.0; checkpoints 2000/4000.
protocol.selection: Frozen rule: highest dev fused top1, ties earlier step then smaller weight -> rw05@4000; CE control best dev step 2000.

findings: Residual training equals the CE-only control on dev (341 vs 341) and held-out (320 vs 320): the fused objective adds nothing measurable at this data scale. Ranking loss fell to ~5e-5 within 4000 steps, so the mined pairs gave almost no gradient.
Fixed fusion (existing final_mode=fused control) beats LM-only on dev 340 vs 333 (blank whole 13 vs 8) but only 321 vs 319 on held-out; both intervals include zero.
Blank-context whole remains the only stratum where fusion helps consistently (dev 8->13, held-out 10->12); with context, fusion and LM are tied.
Legacy is 1.6pp below the new decoder on held-out (single-character 112 vs 115) but about 5x faster at the median.
limitations: One seed, one data scale; mining used the base 25M guide, so pools do not follow a retrained guide.
Timing ran beside other GPU jobs during part of the run.
